common_concerns: Not knowing what a smart lock install should cost — the Airtasker Yarraville locksmith listing carries a resident's own words, "No idea re budget. Looking for quotes", and both the Yarraville and Yarraville West Airtasker pages are built around "fill in a short form and get free quotes", so people here typically approach the job with no price expectation and compare quotes before committing.

Wanting the installer to explain the work and what will be needed next, not just fit the unit — the Airtasker Yarraville West listing's top review singles out "Luis attention to detail and ability to explain to me what he was doing and what I might need next".

Whether the smart lock replaces or sits alongside existing keyed locks — the Airtasker Yarraville review describes a job where the tradesperson "helped me to install Lockly smart lock and adding new locks", i.e. the smart lock was one part of a broader lock job rather than a straight one-for-one swap.

Choosing which lock actually suits the property and whether it ties into other security — the dlook listing for I.O.S. Locksmiths (Yarraville VIC 3013) sells "expert consultation for security upgrades" spanning deadbolts, electronic locks and smart lock solutions to "recommend the best locks that suit the unique requirements of properties in Yarraville", and the Oneflare Yarraville listing bundles "Smartlock installation" with alarm installations, CCTV and digital locks.
